title: Quantum Oracle Engineering
excerpt: A twelve-chapter course on quantum oracle engineering: screening problems for quantum advantage, compiling Monte Carlo rollouts into reversible circuits, and certifying quantum building blocks beyond the reach of any test.
content_html:
Most quantum speedup claims depend on an oracle that exists only on paper. This course teaches the craft of building practical quantum circuits from scratch.

Choose the problem, build the oracle

Make it correct

Count it, test it, judge it
